svg.title: Field Notes
svg.desc: Trace Bloom section banner for Field Notes on lifehacker.dev. The build log of a website that is automating its own author away — plus the occasional joke that survived review. A organic lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Fallback cover for field notes that carry no banner of their own. Seed 121721021.
